title: GetHigh.EXE
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#799, 2026-10-29), the Epic copy, Apple M1, macOS 27.0.1, Highball 0.10.22, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r28, D3DMetal with AVX advertised, rated 2 of 5 after 2 minutes: the game opens on its settings screen at 60 fps and its arrow button did not start anything. A DualSense did not work, an XInput pad did. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Starts and draws at 60 fps on an M1 (Epic), but the reporter could not get from its settings screen into the game. Possibly the game's own menu flow rather than a fault.

knownIssues.symptom: Opens on its settings screen and the arrow button does nothing
knownIssues.cause: not diagnosed, possibly the game's menu flow
knownIssues.fix: untested: Esc or the menu icon at the top left to close the settings
